[EN] Dougal ordered to investigate the location marked on the shifting map, and to take Zolyn along.

Meanwhile, Zolyn was trying hard to figure out where Paesyn was.
rescued Paesyn from monsters and brought him to Zolyn.

Paesyn had picking flowers to make bouquet for Zolyn. Receiving the bouquet, Zolyn is reminded of her missing sister, and forgave Paesyn's earlier, clumsier efforts to cheer her.
[ES] Dougal le ordenó a que investigara la ubicación marcada en el mapa cambiante y que llevara a Zolyn.

Mientras tanto, Zolyn se esforzaba por averiguar dónde estaba Paesyn.
rescató a Paesyn de los monstruos y lo llevó ante Zolyn.

Paesyn había estado cortando flores para hacerle un ramo a Zolyn. Al recibir el ramo, Zolyn recordó a su hermana desaparecida y perdonó los torpes esfuerzos anteriores de Paesyn por animarla.

[EN] Are you going to investigate right now?

You should take Zolyn with you. She's eager to find any clues as to where her sister might be—and if you run into trouble, you'll need her."Good idea. Where can I find her?"
[ES] ¿Vas a investigar ahora mismo?

Deberías llevar a Zolyn contigo. Está ansiosa por encontrar cualquier pista sobre el paradero de su hermana, y si te metes en problemas, la necesitarás."Good idea. Where can I find her?"

[EN] She went looking for Paesyn. He's out picking flowers or something.

Take a look around the area—you're bound to run into her."Okay, thanks."
[ES] Fue a buscar a Paesyn. Él está por ahí cortando flores o algo así.

Echa un vistazo por la zona; seguro que te la encuentras."Okay, thanks."

[EN] I'm looking for Pae— that hairball popori. I can't find him anywhere.

Dougal said he was with you earlier, by the sheep meadow?"I haven't."
[ES] Estoy buscando a Pae... esa bola de pelo popori. No lo encuentro por ningún lado.

Dougal dijo que estaba contigo antes, ¿junto al prado de ovejas?"I haven't."

[EN] Of course; he's the engineer of our ship...and a member of our expedition.

And contrary to what you might think, I actually like him. I just wish he didn't try so hard to make people show that they like him.

What are you looking at? Are you going to help me or not?"It's Paesyn. Of course I'll help."
[ES] Por supuesto; es el ingeniero de nuestro barco... y un miembro de nuestra expedición.

Y al contrario de lo que puedas pensar, en realidad me cae bien. Solo desearía que no se esforzara tanto para hacer que la gente demuestre que les cae bien.

¿Qué miras? ¿Me vas a ayudar o no?"It's Paesyn. Of course I'll help."

[EN] You left him somewhere out here...alone?

I understand that you're the self-sufficient type, and a hero of the Argon War and all that, but not everyone is as capable as you are!

Now, are you going to help me look for him or not?"He's more capable than you think. But yes, I'll help."
[ES] ¿Lo dejaste en algún lugar por aquí... solo?

Entiendo que eres del tipo autosuficiente, un héroe de la Argon War y todo eso, ¡pero no todos son tan capaces como tú!

Ahora, ¿vas a ayudarme a buscarlo o no?"He's more capable than you think. But yes, I'll help."

[EN] (Paesyn clearly came this way...but it's odd that he would drop something like this from his toolbox and not notice.)"Looks like he went this way."
[ES] (Paesyn claramente vino por aquí... pero es extraño que dejara caer algo así de su caja de herramientas sin darse cuenta.)"Looks like he went this way."

[EN] (It's almost as though Paesyn were dropping the heaviest things he was carrying...)"He was running from something..."
[ES] (Es casi como si Paesyn estuviera dejando caer las cosas más pesadas que llevaba...)"He was running from something..."

[EN] I got lost! I must've taken a wrong turn or something, because the next thing I knew, I was surrounded by those...things!"What were you doing out here?"
[ES] ¡Me perdí! ¡Debo haber tomado un giro equivocado o algo así, porque lo siguiente que supe fue que estaba rodeado por esas... cosas!"What were you doing out here?"

[EN] Ah, well...when you didn't come back right away with the springlike flowers, I thought maybe you had forgotten. So I decided to look for them myself—and I found them! I...I guess I wasn't paying too much attention to my surroundings...

Anyway, I've put together a bouquet of flowers for Zolyn.

Oh! Here she comes! Umm, could I ask you to deliver them for me, ?"This is the last time, right? Then okay."
[ES] Ah, bueno... cuando no regresaste de inmediato con las flores primaverales, pensé que tal vez te habías olvidado. Así que decidí buscarlas yo mismo... ¡y las encontré! I... supongo que no estaba prestando demasiada atención a mis alrededores...

De todos modos, armé un ramo de flores para Zolyn.

¡Oh! ¡Allí viene! Mmm, ¿podría pedirte que se las entregues por mí,
?"This is the last time, right? Then okay."

[EN] What's that you've got? Oh, gods! Not another present from that useless hair...ball...

Springlike flowers? My sister and I used to pick these together...

How did you...? Oh, they're from Paesyn, aren't they? Oh, brother...

Brother, I am so sorry for how I've acted! Can you ever forgive me?"I think you just made his day, Zolyn."
[ES] ¿Qué es eso que tienes? ¡Ay, los dioses! ¡Otro regalo de esa inútil bola de... pelo...!

¿Flores primaverales? Mi hermana y yo solíamos recogerlas juntas...

¿Cómo... ¿Oh, son de Paesyn, verdad? Ay, hermano...

¡Hermano, siento mucho cómo me he comportado! ¿Podrás perdonarme alguna vez?"I think you just made his day, Zolyn."

[EN] ! Did you see that?

Zolyn is finally warming up to me! She actually smiled at me! I mean, a real smile—not that "I-can't-wait-to-kill-you" smile she gives her enemies!

I knew she just needed the right gesture to help her cheer up!"She does seem a lot less murder-y. Well done, Paesyn."
[ES] ¡! ¿Viste eso?

¡Zolyn por fin me está tomando aprecio! ¡De verdad me sonrió! O sea, ¡una sonrisa de verdad, no esa sonrisa de "tengo-ganas-de-matarte" que le dedica a sus enemigos!

¡Sabía que solo necesitaba el gesto correcto para animarse!"She does seem a lot less murder-y. Well done, Paesyn."

[EN] ...Okay, that's enough celebrating. Back to work!"...and right back to murder-y."
[ES] ...Bien, basta de celebraciones. ¡A trabajar!"...and right back to murder-y."

[EN] Dougal sent me to help you find some secret laboratory?

Let me get Paesyn somewhere safe, and gather some soldiers, and I'll meet up with you shortly."Sounds good. Take care, Paesyn!"
[ES] ¿Dougal te envió a ayudarme a encontrar un laboratorio secreto?

Déjame llevar a Paesyn a un lugar seguro, reunir a algunos soldados y te alcanzo en un momento."Sounds good. Take care, Paesyn!"
